plainText:
Kanata's Poochyena (カナタ ポチエナ Kanata's Pochiena) is one of the main characters in Pokémon Chamo-Chamo ☆ Pretty ♪. He's the younger brother of .

==History==
Poochyena is introduced along with his Trainer when Torchic mistakes Poochyena as a Prince Charming.

==Personality and characteristics==
Poochyena doesn't get along with at all; he calls her "shorty" and she calls him "hick-Poochy". However, he congratulates her for doing well in a , and comforts her when she's upset at times.
